name: groww-shorts

colors._source: brand.md is the ONLY place colour values live. These are token names, never hex — see CLAUDE.md standing rule.
colors._subscribeRedNote: YouTube's own red — the one deliberate off-palette value.
colors.accentGreenUse: identity-only: logos, wipe sheets, serif takeover titles, CTA headlines — never data ink, never emphasis

chrome.layering: branding and captions above everything, including full-frame wipes

camera.varietyDevice: punch-in crop change between jump cuts
camera._headPushInNote: style.md and the creator both allow zoom-ins/push-ins (directive 2026-08-21). This field read false until 2026-08-22 and contradicted the style file.

exit.note: Exits are designed and matched to the moment; a hard cut is a choice, not the default.

graphics._buildsNote: Table grammar builds with count-ups (style.md), and the creator's own sample clip animates its percentages counting up.

captions.language: English translation of Hindi VO (translation pass after WhisperX; never Devanagari)
captions.interjectionChip: ALL-CAPS short chip stacked above main line
captions.layoutAwareMethod: Solved by measurement: per-frame occupancy map of graphic CONTENT (edge energy, so a smooth gradient background is not a collision), then a Y ladder that clears graphics + face box + safe zones; b-roll is not a collision; suppress the group where nothing clears; suppress across reframe windows because the face moves.

compliance.textSource: user-supplied legal identity — never copied from references

learned: corner branding: wordmark top-right only, white logo on small indigo chip (user decision)
compliance: Groww official SEBI/RA text on file in job assets

grade: Sony SLog3->Rec709 + Maltilde look, stacked (user decision) - applies ONLY when the supplied footage is LOG. Check first: a supplied finished cut is usually already Rec709 and the LUT would wreck it. Test: p1-p99 luma spread and mean saturation.
light leak, dust and caption placement are now MEASURED specs in style.md - do not re-derive them per job (2026-08-22)

graphicZoneBackdrop.blur: gaussian, applied in FFmpeg at composite
graphicZoneBackdrop.note: no visible blur edge — feather generously

contrastScrim.style: subtle gradient, never a visible band

editorRules.tableActLayout: face-cell: during table/data acts the graphic owns the frame; presenter shrinks into a ring-framed circle (~380px, bottom-center, indigo ring) or rounded cell — reference V4 video-cell device. User preference 2026-08-09: more impressive than half-frame split.

rules: constant movement — light transformations between clips, never bare hard cuts on the A-roll
VFX on transitions (whips, curtain wipes, light transforms)
b-roll blended naturally; AI generation only where necessary
element icons (calendar, chart) synced precisely to the spoken word
black text-emphasis gradients VERY subtle, heavily feathered, never over the head
premium + engaging: continuous motion, understated mini-grid

tightCrop.note: For the current raw framing, 660x800 from (210,340) fills a 0.82:1 mask.
